sampling_boundary: TCGA RNA-seq is bulk primary-tumour material. No spatial record links the aliquot to BraTS label-2 edema voxels, tumour core, enhancing tumour or a matched MRI coordinate. Edema is an MRI-derived anatomical truth basis, not a transcriptomic compartment sampled for RNA-seq.
